name: Jaipur City, Rajasthan
description: Jaipur, the "Pink City" of Rajasthan in north-western India, was founded in 1727 by Maharaja Sawai Jai Singh II. Unlike nearby hilltop towns, it was laid out on flat ground in a neat grid, with colonnaded shopfronts of matching design lining the main streets and meeting at broad public squares. Its bazaars still hum with traders and craftspeople today.
